title: 28411 Grandview Manor - Yulee, FL
description: Discover Southern charm, natural beauty and comfortable elegance in this beautifully maintained single-story home in gated Waterman’s Bluff! Featuring hardwood floors, high coffered ceilings, custom fireplace, and a spacious kitchen. The flexible front room is ideal for dining, gathering or a home office, while the primary suite offers a relaxing retreat with a soaking tub and walk-in shower. Recent updates include fresh paint, new lighting, window coverings, and upgraded laundry and mudroom cabinetry. Step outside to an impressive fenced backyard featuring professionally designed landscaping, paver driveway and patio, landscape lighting, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen - perfect for entertaining! Enjoy the screened porch and one of the neighborhood’s larger yards, with room for a future pool. Tankless water heater, whole-house water filtration, and an organized garage with epoxy floors and built-ins add convenience. Enjoy community dock and fishing access, kayaking, and the peaceful riverfront lifestyle all just minutes to the beaches of Amelia Island and the city life of Jacksonville.
